self_review: Challenged every Y/N plus runtime NA against command, host, renderer, QA & release entrypoints. Kept transitive rightkit-fs as Y only where active settings/jobs/logs caller chain is proven. Retained channel-memory N only after confirming active command dispatch reaches local proof parsing/persistence & comparing it with shared parse/control APIs; excluded unimplemented shared citation semantics from claim. Reclassified updates from N to NA: plugin/configuration alone never calls check, download, or install; adapter module is unreachable. Kept product-local proof schema/storage out of generic contracts/review N claims because exact owner overlap is incomplete.
